source._comment: LIVE: the hub loaded the 2026 general on 2026-10-13, under three Election Name variants ('NOVEMBER 3, 2026 - GENERAL ELECTION', '... - GENERAL & SPECIAL ELECTIONS', '... - GENERAL AND SPECIAL ELECTIONS'), with counties' ballots split between the last two; ga_update.py sums every name matching election_match. The Districts view also comes from the hub (Snapshot.CONGRESSIONAL_DISTRICT of each ballot's registration record) once the general is in; the Lab district stand-in stops then. GA SoS 'Election Data Hub - Unofficial Turnout' is a Qlik Cloud app. Its sos.ga.gov page is behind a Cloudflare browser challenge; the Qlik tenant and the public token endpoint the page's S3-hosted mashup (gasos-elections-mashups-mashup-bucket/DH.ELECTION2024) calls for every visitor are not. scripts/qlik.py opens the app like the page does; ga_update.py sums Ballots_*_Counter by County x Ballot Style for the Election Name matching election_match, plus active voters from the newest Snapshot.AsOfDate <= today. Each fetch opens one anonymous Qlik session (as each page visit does). Since the general went live the hub reloads about every 10-20 minutes, so every_minutes=8 reads it on every ~10-minute run (like Florida); fetch_hours_utc (7am/7pm ET) applies only if every_minutes is removed. Verified against NOVEMBER 5, 2024 - GENERAL ELECTION (5,295,967 accepted ballots statewide). The 2026 general was not yet in the hub on 2026-09-23 (26 elections, latest the Aug 25 2026 runoff).
source._fallback_comment: Until the hub lists the general, ga_update.py shows the UF Election Lab's statewide Georgia row (built by the Lab from the SoS absentee voter file, whose download is reCAPTCHA Enterprise-gated and so is not scripted here). Used unaltered, attributed, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (non-commercial). The hub's county-level data replaces it automatically.
